tests.name: token_text_buffer_small_input
tests.intent: Verify token_text_buffer correctly retains small inputs without truncation.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_long_whitespace
tests.intent: Verify that a very long run of whitespace after a number truncates correctly in parse error messages.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_stream_adapter
tests.intent: Verify stream input adapter correctly uses token_text_buffer for long inputs leading to parse errors.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_iterator_adapter
tests.intent: Verify iterator-based parsing correctly handles tokens with text buffer limits.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_exact_head_boundary
tests.intent: Verify token text buffer behavior at the exact head size boundary of 4096 characters.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_exact_limit_boundary
tests.intent: Verify token text buffer behavior around the limit boundary where truncation activates.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_control_characters
tests.intent: Verify control characters inside long token texts are properly escaped.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_string_literal
tests.intent: Verify token text buffer truncation for excessively long string literals.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_clear_state
tests.intent: Verify token text buffer clears correctly between tokens during parsing.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_ordered_json
tests.intent: Verify token text buffer behavior with ordered_json parser error messages.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_multiple_errors
tests.intent: Verify multiple consecutive parse operations reuse or reset the token buffer cleanly.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_empty_stream
tests.intent: Verify empty stream error handling interacts correctly with token buffers.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_unicode_characters
tests.intent: Verify unicode characters embedded in long tokens do not break buffer boundary checks.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_deep_nesting
tests.intent: Verify token text buffering during deeply nested invalid structures.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_file_adapter
tests.intent: Verify file-based input stream parsing uses token buffers properly via temporary streams.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_huge_number
tests.intent: Verify parsing of an extremely long numeric token followed by invalid characters.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_list_char_adapter
tests.intent: Verify std::list<char> input adapter handles token text truncation efficiently.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_discard_middle
tests.intent: Verify that middle truncation correctly preserves start and end segments in error messages.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_allow_comments
tests.intent: Verify token buffering behavior when parsing with comments enabled on long whitespace streams.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_sax_interface
tests.intent: Verify SAX parser interface correctly propagates truncated last tokens in parse errors.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_sax_interface_fixed
tests.intent: Verify SAX parser interface correctly propagates truncated last tokens in parse errors.

tests.name: token_text_buffer_sax_interface_fixed_fixed
tests.intent: Verify SAX parser interface correctly propagates truncated last tokens in parse errors.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Instantiate token_text_buffer<wchar_t> explicitly via move assignment and copy/move constructors to cover move assignment and data members.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Trigger block-level append in token_text_buffer where n > room and memcpy is directly invoked with multiple character slices.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Trigger memmove inside token_text_buffer make_room by pushing enough characters beyond limit() so that the middle section gets dropped and memmove runs.

tests.name: gen_26
tests.intent: Parse an input whose token length falls into the else branch (short token <= head + tail) during seekable range copying, avoiding multi-segment splitting.

tests.name: gen_27
tests.intent: Exercise bulk_track_token and non-lazy token collection paths using a custom iterator adapter that feeds bulk blocks to the lexer.
